title: 饼图的构成比较
goal: 确定比例对应的总体，区分构成变化与数量变化。

points.label: 确定百分比所对应的总体
区分构成变化与数量变化

body.p: 饼图的百分比是各类别在总体中所占的份额。读图先确认总体和时间，再比较最大的部分、其余部分和两期的构成。
比较两期时，份额的变化是构成的变化。两期的总体可能不同，所以份额上升时，该类别的数量可能下降。

body.box:
2020: 50% of 100 = 50.
2022: 60% of 60 = 36.
The share rose, but the number fell.

steps.d: 读取图题和时间。百分比的分母是相应年份的总体，例如当年的全部支出。
先找出最大的部分，再看其余各部分。同一总体中的份额可以直接比较，如 40% 大于 30%。
对照同一类别在两期的份额。从 20% 到 30%，是份额增加 10 个百分点。
给出总体数值时，用总体乘以百分比，算出数量。没有总体数值时，只描述份额的变化。

cards.title: 构成与总体
rows: Food accounted for the largest share.
Travel and other costs each made up 30%.
The share of travel increased by 10 percentage points.
总量 100 中占 50%，总量 60 中占 60%
The share rose, while the number fell from 50 to 36.

body.p: 2020 年 staff 占比最大，2024 年 premises 占比最大。两者各变动 10 个百分点。equipment 和 events 的份额不变。图中没有支出总额，所以不写金额的变化。

body.box: Staff represented the largest share in 2020, but premises became the largest category in 2024. Equipment and events retained their respective shares. Staff accounted for 40% of expenditure in the first year and 30% in the second. The share for premises moved in the opposite direction, from 30% to 40%. Equipment remained at 20%, while events made up 10% of each year's expenditure.

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 40% of all residents was spent on staff.
40% 指 2020 年支出，不是居民人数。
Events made up the largest share in 2020.
份额上升，但总支出未知。

items.stem: In 2020, 40% of a centre's spending went on staff. What is the whole?
options: The centre's spending on staff in 2020
items.why: 40% of a centre's spending 的总体是 2020 年的全部支出，即第一项。staff 是其中的一部分，不是总体。

items.stem: A share is 20% in 2020 and 30% in 2024; totals are unknown. What is supported?
options: The share rose by 10 percentage points.
The share fell by 10 percentage points.
items.why: 30% 减 20% 为 10 个百分点，第二项只陈述份额。

items.stem: A category is 50% of 100 items, then 60% of 60 items. What happened?
options: The share and number both fell.
The share fell and the number rose.
The share rose and the number fell.
The share and number both rose.
items.why: 份额从 50% 升至 60%，数量从 50 降至 36，第三项正确。

items.stem: Shares of a budget are staff 40%, premises 30%, equipment 20% and events 10%. Which is largest?
items.why: 40% 是该预算的四个份额中最大值。

groups.text:
Share of a school's annual energy use
       2019   2023
Heating 40%    30%
Lighting 30%   40%
Cooking 20%    20%
Other   10%    10%
Total energy use is not given.

items.stem: Which category had the largest share in 2023?
items.why: 2023 年 lighting 的 40% 最大。

items.stem: What can be concluded about lighting?
options: Its share increased by 10 percentage points.
Its energy use increased by 10 units.
Its share decreased by 10 percentage points.
Its energy use decreased by 10 units.
items.why: 照明份额从 30% 增至 40%，总用量未知。

items.stem: What is the whole for the 2024 percentages?
options: The museum's spending on staff in 2024

items.why: 2020 年 staff 的 40% 是最大份额。

items.stem: What happened to the share of premises?
options: It stayed at 30% in both years.
items.why: Premises 从 30% 增至 40%，相差 10 个百分点。

items.stem: What can be concluded about the amount spent on premises?

It decreased by 10 units over the period.

items.why: 总支出未知，份额上升不足以确定金额变化。
